tags.name: WorkflowService
tags.description: WorkflowService starts and observes workflow runs.

tags.name: A2AService
tags.description:
A2AService is the A2A protocol surface external agents call. It maps the
task vocabulary onto runs and reuses the WorkflowService run lifecycle, so
an A2A task and an API run are the same persisted record. SendMessage maps
a conversation onto a chat session instead, through the same bridge core
Telegram and Mattermost drive.

tags.name: RunnerPlugin
tags.description:
RunnerPlugin mirrors the pkg/runner contract for one out-of-process
runner: Describe is the startup handshake, Validate checks params, and
Execute streams incremental chunks before one terminal result or error.

tags.name: AdminService
tags.description: AdminService covers operator concerns outside any single workflow.

tags.name: LoginService
tags.description:
LoginService exchanges access keys for bearer tokens and revokes tokens.
Login itself is tokenless (it is the way in); Revoke requires the admin
scope, enforced by the auth interceptor like every other method.

tags.name: ChatService
tags.description:
ChatService holds conversations with the CairnOS agent. Every method takes
the chat:session scope; SendMessage that proposes a workflow additionally
needs write:workflow on the token, enforced at ConfirmAction.

tags.name: GovernanceService
tags.description: GovernanceService covers budget visibility and the admin control actions.

tags.name: MemoryService
tags.description: MemoryService manages the bounded, curated notes loaded into prompts.

tags.name: MessagingService
tags.description:
MessagingService posts messages as a configured identity. Both methods take
the message:send scope.

tags.name: LanguageRulesService
tags.description: LanguageRulesService is the typed API over the Language Rules Service.

tags.name: SuggestionService
tags.description:
SuggestionService manages the human review queue over persisted tuning
suggestions.

tags.name: VaultService
tags.description:
VaultService manages the Obsidian-style document store and its typed graph
query.

post.summary:
SendMessage runs one conversational turn with this node and returns the
reply. context_id names the conversation: the same id on a later call
continues the same chat session, so a peer holds a multi-turn exchange
rather than a series of unrelated questions (FR36). A turn that ends on a
workflow proposal answers with state "input-required" and the proposal
filled; the peer approves or denies it by sending "approve" or "deny" on
the same context_id.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description:
SendMessageRequest carries one conversational turn. context_id is the
peer's own conversation handle; an empty one starts a fresh conversation
that the response's context_id names for follow-ups.

get.summary: ListTasks lists tasks newest-first, backed by ListRuns.

parameters.name: skill
parameters.description: skill narrows to one workflow name; empty means all.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: state narrows to one task state; empty means all.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: limit caps the result count; zero means the server default.

post.summary:
CreateTask starts a run from an A2A task request: the skill names the
workflow, params become workflow inputs. It returns the created task
(run) without waiting for completion; TaskUpdates streams progress.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description:
CreateTaskRequest names the skill (workflow) and supplies its params
(inputs). The optional client_task_id is echoed back for correlation; it
does not become the run id, which the node mints.

get.summary: GetTask reads one task's current state, backed by GetRun.

post.summary:
CancelTask stops an in-flight task started through this node, backed by
CancelRun.

get.summary:
TaskUpdates streams one task's run and action events until it finalizes,
backed by the WorkflowService run event stream. Over HTTP the gateway
delivers it as newline-delimited JSON, one update per line.

post.summary:
Revoke denylists one token by jti, or every live token minted from one
access key by key id. Requires the admin scope.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: RevokeRequest names exactly one revocation target: jti or key_id.

get.summary: SearchMessages runs full-text search over the workspace's transcripts.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: text is the full-text query; empty is InvalidArgument.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: session_id optionally narrows hits to one session.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: limit caps the result count; zero means no cap, matching SearchMemory.

get.summary: ListSessions lists the workspace's sessions, most-recently-updated first.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: limit caps the result count; zero means no cap.

post.summary: CreateSession opens a new conversation with a personality.

get.summary: GetSession fetches one session's metadata.

post.summary:
ConfirmAction resolves a pending workflow proposal: approve fires the
workflow and streams its run events, deny clears the gate and runs
nothing. Approve additionally requires write:workflow on the token.

get.summary: ListMessages returns one session's full transcript in order.

post.summary:
SendMessage runs one conversation turn for a new user message and streams
its events: assistant text chunks, tool-call events, a
confirmation-required event when the agent proposes a workflow, run
started/finished events when a confirmed workflow fires, and a closing
turn-done event. The HTTP gateway delivers the stream as chunked
newline-delimited JSON, one event per line.

get.summary: ListAudit lists governance audit rows newest-first.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: limit caps the result count; zero means the server default.

post.summary:
TerminateRun cancels an active run; it maps to the same machinery as
CancelRun. Admin scope; audit-logged.

get.summary:
GetWorkflowBudgetState reports a workflow's current-period spend, its
configured limit and period, and whether it is paused. Spend rides on
estimated cost, so it is a soft ceiling, not a billed total.

post.summary:
PauseWorkflow blocks new runs of a workflow until it is resumed. In-flight
runs finish. Admin scope; audit-logged.
ResumeWorkflow lifts a workflow's pause flag. Admin scope; audit-logged.

get.summary: Health reports liveness and store readiness. Never requires auth.

post.summary:
Login exchanges a valid, enabled access key for a short-lived token
carrying the key's scopes. The long-lived key crosses the wire here,
which is why a non-loopback bind demands TLS
(.agents/spec/08-auth-and-access.md, "Model").

get.summary:
SearchMemory returns entries relevant to the query: keyword by default,
semantic when a vector backend is configured.

parameters.name: semantic
parameters.description:
semantic asks for vector search when a backend is configured; keyword
search answers otherwise and fallback is set in the response.

post.summary: AddMemory persists a new entry and returns its id.

get.summary: GetMemory fetches one entry by id.

delete.summary: DeleteMemory removes one entry by id.

put.summary:
ReplaceMemory overwrites an entry's content, scope, importance, tags,
and token cost.

post.summary: SendMessage posts text as one identity and returns the created post.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description:
MessagingServiceSendMessageRequest carries one send. The name is
service-qualified because cairnos.v1 already holds ChatService's
SendMessageRequest, and both land in one Go package.

get.summary: ListIdentities lists the identities a caller may send as.
ListLanguages returns the distinct languages with at least one rule.

post.summary:
PutRule upserts one rule keyed by (language, project, key). An empty
project sets a language default.

get.summary:
GetRules returns the merged rule set for a language, optionally narrowed
to a project: language defaults with the project's overrides applied.
ListRunners lists the registered runner names.

post.summary: ResetBreaker resets one runner's circuit breaker.

get.summary: ListRuns lists runs newest-first, filterable by workflow and status.

parameters.name: workflow
parameters.description: workflow narrows to one workflow name; empty means all.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: status narrows to one run status; empty means all.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: limit caps the result count; zero means the server default.

get.summary: GetRun fetches one run's current state, including its action results.

post.summary:
ApproveRun decides a pending approval gate on a held run: approve lets
the gated action succeed, deny fails it with action.approval_denied
under normal error handling. Either way the run resumes asynchronously;
the response acknowledges the decision like CancelRun's ack, and GetRun
reports where the resumed run lands.
CancelRun cancels an in-flight run started through this server.

ReplayRun reruns a prior run from its first failed action: prior
succeeded actions keep their outputs and the rest re-execute, streaming
the new run's events like RunWorkflow. A workflow-hash mismatch is
refused unless force is set.

get.summary: ListSuggestions lists suggestions newest-first, filterable by status.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: status narrows to one review state; empty means all.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: limit caps the result count; zero means the server default.

post.summary:
ApproveSuggestion marks a suggestion approved and returns the annotated
change for the operator to apply by hand. Nothing is written to
workflow or config files.
RejectSuggestion marks a suggestion rejected.

PutDocument persists a new document or overwrites an existing one and
returns its id.

QueryVault runs the typed graph query: tag and project filtering, bounded
link traversal, and keyword text match.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description:
QueryVaultRequest is the typed graph query DSL over the wire. Every field is
optional and AND-combined.

get.summary: GetDocument fetches one document by id, with its derived backlinks.

delete.summary: DeleteDocument removes one document and its links.

post.summary:
ValidateWorkflow parses and validates a workflow file without running
it, returning every canonical validation error found in one pass.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description:
ValidateWorkflowRequest carries the raw workflow file bytes (TOML). Over
HTTP/JSON the bytes field is base64-encoded, per proto3 JSON mapping.

put.summary:
SaveWorkflow validates a workflow definition and writes it into the
server's workflows directory. Overwriting an existing workflow captures
the prior definition in the version store first, so the save is
rollbackable via the suggestions revert path.

post.summary:
RunWorkflow starts a run by workflow name and streams run and action
events as they happen. The HTTP gateway delivers the stream as chunked
newline-delimited JSON, one event per line.

approve.description: approve fires the pending workflow; deny clears the gate without running.

reason.description: reason is recorded in the audit row and on the pause flag.

approve.description:
approve decides the gate: true approves, false denies. Denial fails the
gated action with action.approval_denied under normal error handling.

comment.description: comment is an optional decision note recorded on the gate.

WorkflowServiceApproveRunBody.description:
ApproveRunRequest decides one pending approval gate on a held run.
action_name may be omitted when exactly one gate is pending; with zero or
several pending the request is refused, the several case listing the
candidate action names (.agents/spec/parity/workflow-language.md, "Human
approval").

force.description:
force replays even when the current workflow file's hash differs from the
hash the prior run recorded.

WorkflowServiceReplayRunBody.description:
ReplayRunRequest names the prior run to replay and whether to override the
workflow-hash guard when the file has changed since the original run.

toml.description:
toml, when set, runs this definition inline instead of resolving by name,
the builder's test-action path. Over HTTP/JSON the bytes are
base64-encoded, per proto3 JSON mapping.

WorkflowServiceRunWorkflowBody.description:
RunWorkflowRequest names the workflow (resolved against the server's
workflows directory) and supplies its declared inputs.

WorkflowServiceSaveWorkflowBody.description:
SaveWorkflowRequest carries the target workflow name (from the URL path) and
the raw definition bytes (TOML). Over HTTP/JSON the bytes field is
base64-encoded, per proto3 JSON mapping. The definition's own name must
match workflow_name or the save is refused.

cairnosA2aV1SendMessageRequest.description:
SendMessageRequest carries one conversational turn. context_id is the
peer's own conversation handle; an empty one starts a fresh conversation
that the response's context_id names for follow-ups.

createdAt.description:
created_at, started_at, and finished_at echo the run timestamps as
RFC 3339 strings so an HTTP-only consumer needs no protobuf timestamp
decoding.

cairnosA2aV1Task.description:
Task is one unit of A2A work, the wire shape of a CairnOS run. task_id is
the run id, skill is the workflow name, and params are the run inputs.

cairnosV1Usage.description: Usage is the per-action resource accounting from the runner.

protobufNullValue.description:
`NullValue` is a singleton enumeration to represent the null value for the
`Value` type union.

The JSON representation for `NullValue` is JSON `null`.

 - NULL_VALUE: Null value.

output.description: output is the action's result value, JSON-shaped.

v1ActionResult.description: ActionResult is the persisted outcome of one action within a run.

status.description:
status is the action lifecycle state:
pending|ready|running|succeeded|failed|skipped.

v1ActionState.description: ActionState is one action's position within a run at event time.

actionName.description:
action_name is the gate that was decided, resolved when the request
omitted it.

approved.description: approved echoes the decision the gate recorded.

status.description: status acknowledges the resume signal, mirroring CancelRun's ack shape.

v1ApproveRunResponse.description:
ApproveRunResponse acknowledges the decision; the run resumes
asynchronously and lands in run history when its loop settles.

annotation.description: annotation is the rendered change for the operator to apply by hand.

actor.description: actor is the auth subject when present, else "cli" or "local".

action.description: action is pause, resume, or terminate.

target.description: target is the workflow name or run id the action applied to.

detail.description: detail is free-form context, such as a pause reason.

v1AuditEntry.description: AuditEntry is one governance audit row.

v1CancelRunResponse.description:
CancelRunResponse acknowledges the cancel signal; the run finalizes
asynchronously and lands in run history as canceled.

v1CancelTaskResponse.description:
CancelTaskResponse acknowledges the cancel signal; the task finalizes
asynchronously and lands in history as canceled.

text.description:
text carries assistant reply text on ASSISTANT_CHUNK and the final reply
on TURN_DONE.

tool.description: tool and tool_input are set on TOOL_CALL.

runId.description: run_id is set on RUN_STARTED and RUN_FINISHED; run_status on RUN_FINISHED.

v1ChatEvent.description:
ChatEvent is one entry in a turn's stream. Only the fields a given type uses
are set.

v1ChatEventType.description: ChatEventType says what a ChatEvent describes.

role.description: role is user, assistant, or tool.

sessionId.description:
session_id names the conversation the message belongs to, so a search
hit identifies its session without a separate lookup.

v1ChatMessage.description: ChatMessage is one entry in a conversation.

personality.description: personality names the session's personality; empty uses the default.

v1CreateTaskRequest.description:
CreateTaskRequest names the skill (workflow) and supplies its params
(inputs). The optional client_task_id is echoed back for correlation; it
does not become the run id, which the node mints.

clientTaskId.description: client_task_id echoes the request's correlation id, if any.

code.description: code is the canonical dotted identifier, e.g. "workflow.cycle_detected".

message.description: message is the human-readable explanation, safe to show users.

details.description:
details carries structured context such as the cycle path or the
missing key.

v1Error.description:
Error is the canonical engine error: a stable dotted code, a message safe
to surface, and structured details for programmatic consumers. It mirrors
internal/cairnerr.Error and rides in gRPC status details so the gateway
can rebuild the canonical HTTP error envelope.

rules.description: rules is the merged set: language defaults with project overrides applied.

actions.description:
actions carries the run's per-action results, reusing the WorkflowService
ActionResult shape so A2A and the native API report the same detail.

hasBudget.description:
has_budget is false when the workflow declares no [workflow.budget]; the
spend, limit, and period fields are then meaningless.

period.description: period is day, week, or month; empty when has_budget is false.

spendUsd.description: spend_usd is the estimated spend for the current period.

limitUsd.description: limit_usd is the configured ceiling; zero when has_budget is false.

onExceed.description: on_exceed is pause or warn; empty when has_budget is false.

paused.description: paused is true when an admin paused the workflow.

status.description: status is "ok" when the config loaded and the store answers.

v1Identity.description:
Identity describes one configured send surface. transport names the chat
system behind it (mattermost, telegram); username and display_name are the
account a recipient sees; url is the server the identity posts to.

v1LanguageRule.description:
LanguageRule is one coding-standard entry. An empty project means a language
default applying to every project in that language.

key.description: key is the plaintext access key printed once by `cairnos keys add`.

token.description: token is the signed JWT to present as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

expiresAt.description:
expires_at is the token's exp; clients re-call Login with their access
key for a fresh token (.agents/spec/08-auth-and-access.md, Change 2).

importance.description: importance (0..100) drives load ordering and eviction.

tokenCost.description: token_cost is the measured token length of content.

identity.description: identity names a configured identity; an unknown name is NotFound.

to.description:
to is the target in one of four forms: "#channel-name", "@username",
"channel:<id>", or "user:<id>". A bare id is InvalidArgument (FR27).

text.description:
text is the message body, sent unmodified so Mattermost renders any
mentions it contains (FR29). Empty is InvalidArgument.

threadId.description: thread_id optionally roots the post in an existing thread.

v1MessagingServiceSendMessageRequest.description:
MessagingServiceSendMessageRequest carries one send. The name is
service-qualified because cairnos.v1 already holds ChatService's
SendMessageRequest, and both land in one Go package.

v1MessagingServiceSendMessageResponse.description:
MessagingServiceSendMessageResponse identifies the created post, so a caller
can thread a follow-up onto it.

v1Proposal.description:
Proposal is a workflow the node wants to run on the peer's behalf, awaiting
the peer's decision. Approving additionally requires write:workflow on the
peer's token (FR37).

tags.description: tags narrows to documents carrying every listed tag.

project.description: project narrows to one project (a "project:<name>" tag convention).

linkedFrom.description: linked_from is a document id whose link graph is traversed.

hops.description: hops bounds the link traversal depth from linked_from.

text.description: text is a keyword match over title and body.

limit.description: limit caps the result count; zero means no cap.

semantic.description:
semantic asks for vector search when a backend is configured; keyword
search answers otherwise and fallback is set in the response.

v1QueryVaultRequest.description:
QueryVaultRequest is the typed graph query DSL over the wire. Every field is
optional and AND-combined.

fallback.description:
fallback is true when semantic search was requested but keyword search
answered because no vector backend is configured.

state.description: state is the breaker position after the reset: CLOSED.

resumed.description: resumed is false when the workflow was not paused to begin with.

jti.description: jti denylists one token until any token with that id could expire.

keyId.description:
key_id denylists every live token minted from one access key. The key
itself stays enabled and can mint fresh tokens; disable the key with
`cairnos keys disable` to stop logins too.

v1RevokeRequest.description: RevokeRequest names exactly one revocation target: jti or key_id.

denied.description: denied echoes the denylisted target: "jti:<id>" or "key:<id>".

status.description:
status is the run lifecycle state:
pending|running|succeeded|failed|canceled|held.

trigger.description: trigger records what started the run: cli|schedule|api|a2a|webhook.

v1Run.description: Run is one execution of a workflow, mirroring the persisted run row.

action.description: action is set on ACTION_TRANSITION events.

run.description: run is set on RUN_FINISHED with the terminal run record.

error.description: error is set when the transition or the run carried a failure.

v1RunEvent.description: RunEvent is one entry in the RunWorkflow stream.

v1RunEventType.description: RunEventType says what a RunEvent describes.

hash.description: hash is the hex SHA-256 of the new file bytes.

priorHash.description: prior_hash is the hash of the replaced definition; empty on create.

created.description: created is true when no file carried this name before the save.

v1SaveWorkflowResponse.description:
SaveWorkflowResponse reports the written definition's identity and whether
the save replaced a prior file.

confidence.description:
confidence is low, medium, or high. Output-changing kinds never rise
above low in Phase 3.

v1Savings.description:
Savings is an estimated improvement with a confidence band, never a
promise.

fallback.description:
fallback is true when semantic search was requested but keyword search
answered because no vector backend is configured.

proposal.description: proposal is set only when state is "input-required".

v1SendMessageResponse.description:
SendMessageResponse carries the turn's reply. state is "completed" for an
ordinary answer and "input-required" when the turn ended on a proposal
awaiting an approve or deny on the same context_id.

kind.description: kind is caching, batching, or param_tuning.

target.description: target is the workflow or "workflow.action" the change applies to.

status.description: status is open, approved, or rejected.

rationale.description: rationale explains the proposal in plain language with its evidence.

evidence.description: evidence carries the metrics that triggered the suggestion.

proposed.description: proposed carries the concrete change being proposed.

v1Suggestion.description: Suggestion is one evidence-backed tuning proposal awaiting human review.

v1TaskState.description:
TaskState is one task's lifecycle position, the A2A spelling of a run
status. The values mirror run status one to one
(pending|running|succeeded|failed|canceled), so consumers that only speak
A2A never see CairnOS run vocabulary.

v1TaskStep.description: TaskStep is one action's position within a task at update time.

step.description: step is set on ACTION updates: the action name, its status, and attempt.

task.description: task is set on the FINISHED update with the terminal task record.

error.description: error is set when the step or the task carried a failure.

v1TaskUpdate.description:
TaskUpdate is one entry in the TaskUpdates stream, the A2A wire shape of a
run event. step is set on action updates; task carries the terminal task
record on the finished update.

v1TaskUpdateType.description:
TaskUpdateType says what a TaskUpdate describes, the A2A spelling of the
run event types.

status.description: status acknowledges the cancel signal; the run finalizes as canceled.

v1ValidateWorkflowRequest.description:
ValidateWorkflowRequest carries the raw workflow file bytes (TOML). Over
HTTP/JSON the bytes field is base64-encoded, per proto3 JSON mapping.

errors.description:
errors lists every canonical validation problem found, so authors fix a
file in one pass.

links.description: links are outbound document ids this one references.

backlinks.description: backlinks are inbound document ids (derived, ignored on put).

v1VaultDocument.description:
VaultDocument is one vault entry. links are outbound references; backlinks
are the derived inbound set, populated on a get and read-only on a put.

v1WorkflowProposal.description:
WorkflowProposal is the D9 confirmation payload: the workflow the agent wants
to run, its inputs, and the estimated spend, shown so the user approves from
full information.
